segments.text: What if Naruto's shadow clones went on strike? Bro got canceled by his own unpaid staff.
segments.label: THE CLONES HAVE DEMANDS

segments.text: Two hundred Narutos cross their arms. Same face, same trauma. Terrifying customer service.
segments.label: TWO HUNDRED IDENTICAL COMPLAINTS

segments.text: He says, we're the same person. Exactly, boss. We know you'll volunteer us.
segments.label: THE ORIGINAL IS CONFUSED

segments.text: Training stops. Missions fall behind. Konoha discovers its productivity plan was one exhausted teenager .
segments.label: TRAINING IS NOW DELAYED

segments.text: Kakashi looks up. He's never seen a meeting this orange.
segments.label: MANAGEMENT HAS LOGGED OFF

segments.text: The clones explain that their painful memories return to Naruto. He's exploiting himself with extra steps.
segments.label: MEMORIES COME BACK TOO

segments.text: He proposes shorter rotations and actual breaks. Character development gets a lunch schedule attached.
segments.label: AN ACTUAL CONCESSION

segments.text: Smaller squads test strategies before everyone commits. Fewer bodies, better information. An actual tactical upgrade appears.
segments.label: SMALLER SQUAD SMARTER PLAN

segments.text: They still split his chakra. This union negotiates breaks, not a physics refund. Please stay serious.
segments.label: THEY STILL SHARE CHAKRA

segments.text: Opponents now face coordinated scouts and decoys instead of orange dudes arguing over who gets punched.
segments.label: THE ENEMY MEETS A TEAM

segments.text: One clone asks who elected the original leader. Mother father. His entire forehead just lost confidence.
segments.label: WHO APPROVED THE LEADER

segments.text: Naruto joins the strike. Everyone demands ramen. Unfortunately, their revolutionary movement still shares exactly one wallet.
segments.label: THE BOSS JOINS THE PICKET
